units: Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ (ref. to Cant. I, 2) חֲשׁוֹק שׂפתותיך זו בזו press thy lips together and be not too hasty in replying.—2) (cmp. חָפַץ) to be attached to, in love with; to elect.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 8:4">Tosef. Yeb. VIII, 4</cite> <he>חָשְׁקָה … בתורה</he> my soul has chosen the Law (as bride); <cite ref="Yevamot 63b:18">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 89a:5">Ḥull. 89ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:7">Deut. VII, 7</cite>) <he>חוֹשְׁקַנִי בכם</he> I elected you.
